shadow_read.flow: primary read via legacy user_id path returns response to user; candidate read via tenant/membership path executes async; results compared; only divergence logged
shadow_read.comparison: row-id set diff + column-hash for sampled rows
shadow_read.sampling: 10% of requests initially; raise to 100% after 72h clean
shadow_read.tolerance: 0 divergences on identity set; column diffs tolerated only for computed audit fields
shadow_read.logs: divergence event contains: route, table, tenant_candidate, count_legacy, count_candidate, diff_ids (up to 25), no PII
shadow_read.performance_budget: candidate read must add <=150ms p95; else auto-disable
shadow_read.disable_trigger: any divergence in identity set OR >5% error rate OR latency budget exceeded
shadow_read.promotion_criteria: 7 consecutive days, 100% sampling, zero identity divergence, human sign-off

dual_validation.definition: evaluate legacy authorization AND candidate membership authorization for every mutation; block only per flag
dual_validation.promotion: block_on_disagreement enabled per-tenant after 7 days clean

dual_write.note: NOT the first production activation; considered only after Shadow+DualValidation prove parity
